fields.reason: Per-category sum of PRICED rows. Unknown-exposure rows are EXCLUDED rather than added as 0, which is why the map can hold numbers while the total is null. A category present in the map has rows and a real sum. Never null itself: the honest answer for an unknown category is ABSENCE.
